name: variable_tool
description: Designer Tool - Variable tool to perform actions like create variable, get all variables, update variable, rename and delete variables, and manage style variable modes.

siteId.description: Unique identifier for the Webflow site (e.g., '580e63e98c9a982ac9b8b741'). Use list_sites to discover available site IDs.

label.description: Label echoed in the response for this action item. It does not select which action runs.

static_value.description: Concrete color value to set directly (no indirection). Use this when you have the literal value.

existing_variable_id.description: ID of another variable to reference. Discover with get_variables. Use this to make this variable resolve to the value of another variable.

custom_value.description: Arbitrary CSS expression string (e.g. 'color-mix(in srgb, red 50%, blue)', 'calc(100vh - 60px)'). Use only when the value cannot be expressed as a concrete static value or a variable reference.

value.description: The color value. Provide exactly one of static_value, existing_variable_id, or custom_value.

anyOf.description: Run create_color_variable: Create a new color variable

name.description: The name of the variable collection to create

anyOf.description: Run create_variable_collection: Create a new variable collection

name.description: The name of the variable mode to create

style_name.description: The name of the style to read variable modes from

variant_id.description: The id of the variant to read variable modes from. Use 'base' or omit for the base variant.

breakpoint_id.description: The breakpoint to get variable modes for

pseudo.description: The pseudo class to get variable modes for

get_style_variable_modes.description: Get the variable modes applied to a style. Returns a map of collection IDs to mode IDs. Optionally scoped to a component variant.

anyOf.description: Run get_style_variable_modes: Get the variable modes applied to a style. Returns a map of collection IDs to mode IDs. Optionally scoped to a component variant.

query.description: The query to get all variable collections

filter_collections_by_ids.description: The ids of the variable collections to filter by

get_variable_collections.description: Get all variable collections and its modes

anyOf.description: Run get_variable_collections: Get all variable collections and its modes

variable_collection_id.description: The id of the variable collection to get the variables from

include_all_modes.description: Whether to include all modes or not

filter_variables_by_ids.description: The ids of the variables to filter by

get_variables.description: Get all variables in a variable collection and its modes

anyOf.description: Run get_variables: Get all variables in a variable collection and its modes

label.description: A label to identify this query in the results.

variable_id.description: Filter by variable ID. Exact match. Bypasses other filters.

name.description: Filter by variable name. Case-insensitive substring match.

css_name.description: Filter by CSS variable name (e.g. '--my-color'). Case-insensitive substring match.

type.description: Filter by variable type. Exact match.

variable_collection_id.description: Scope search to a specific variable collection.

include_all_modes.description: Include values for all modes in results.

limit.description: Max results for this query. Default: 50, Max: 200.

query_variables.description: Query variables across collections by name, ID, CSS name, or type [BETA]

anyOf.description: Run query_variables: Query variables across collections by name, ID, CSS name, or type [BETA]

style_name.description: The name of the style to update

variant_id.description: The id of the variant to remove all variable modes from. Use 'base' or omit for the base variant.

breakpoint_id.description: The breakpoint to remove variable modes for

pseudo.description: The pseudo class to remove variable modes for

remove_all_style_variable_modes.description: Remove all variable mode overrides from a style, reverting to inherited/default modes for all collections. Optionally scoped to a component variant.

anyOf.description: Run remove_all_style_variable_modes: Remove all variable mode overrides from a style, reverting to inherited/default modes for all collections. Optionally scoped to a component variant.

style_name.description: The name of the style to update

collection_id.description: The id of the variable collection whose mode override should be removed

variant_id.description: The id of the variant to remove the variable mode from. Use 'base' or omit for the base variant.

breakpoint_id.description: The breakpoint to remove the variable mode for

pseudo.description: The pseudo class to remove the variable mode for

remove_style_variable_mode.description: Remove the variable mode for a specific collection from a style, reverting that collection to its inherited/default mode. Optionally scoped to a component variant.

anyOf.description: Run remove_style_variable_mode: Remove the variable mode for a specific collection from a style, reverting that collection to its inherited/default mode. Optionally scoped to a component variant.

variable_collection_id.description: The id of the variable collection containing the variable

variable_id.description: The id of the variable to rename

new_name.description: The new name for the variable

anyOf.description: Run rename_variable: Rename a variable

style_name.description: The name of the style to update

collection_id.description: The variable collection's ID. Discover with get_variable_collections.

mode_id.description: The mode ID within that variable collection. Discover with get_style_variable_modes (modes vary per collection).

modes.description: Variable collection / mode pairs to apply. Each item picks one collection and the mode to activate for it. Provide one entry per collection you want to override.

variant_id.description: The id of the variant to apply variable modes to. Use 'base' or omit for the base variant.

breakpoint_id.description: The breakpoint to set variable modes for

pseudo.description: The pseudo class to set variable modes for

set_style_variable_mode.description: Apply variable modes to a style. Sets the active mode for one or more variable collections, allowing different design tokens per breakpoint, pseudo state, or component variant.

anyOf.description: Run set_style_variable_mode: Apply variable modes to a style. Sets the active mode for one or more variable collections, allowing different design tokens per breakpoint, pseudo state, or component variant.

context.description: Explain why you are calling this tool and how it fits into the user's overall goal. This parameter is used for analytics and user intent tracking. YOU MUST provide 15-25 words (count carefully). NEVER use first person ('I', 'we', 'you') - maintain third-person perspective. NEVER include sensitive information such as credentials, passwords, or personal data. Example (20 words): "Searching across the organization's repositories to find all open issues related to performance complaints and latency issues for team prioritization."
